owner: fable (build mandate B1); strategist reviews before ship
_note: ADR-069 binds this version: no consensus input anywhere in the ordering path; steering metric is absolute quality vs realised outcomes; CLAUDE.md 6.5's four-baseline comparison is a release gate run later, by someone other than fable, and is deliberately absent from this config.

engine.harness: experiments.bottomup.components.pos_eval.WalkForward (subclassed for model construction only; gates and audit inherited)

ordering_path.rule: sort by proj_points computed from stat lines under the league scoring config; ties by player_id for determinism
ordering_path.consensus_inputs: none — no ADP, no ECR, no rank-space assembly, no rookie pinning
ordering_path.rookies: own sub-model (log_draft_pick + age, April-of-N information); flagged entry=rookie in the artifact; excluded from graded cells; quality reported descriptively and honestly

G1.fit: binom_glm(logit, ridge 1e-4) on (games, season_len), veteran training rows, per position, features standardised on training rows

G2.adoption_conditional_on: strategist as-of ruling (week-1 status postdates a late-August draft by days)

stat_line_artifact.columns_contract: player_id, season, position, entry, proj_games, per-game and per-season volumes (targets/receptions/rec_yards/rec_tds/carries/rush_yards/rush_tds/attempts/pass_yards/pass_tds/interceptions/fumbles_lost), p_<fam>_<t> exceedance probabilities, proj_points_base, proj_bonus_points, proj_points, plus realised outcome columns for evaluation only
stat_line_artifact.scoring_layer: experiments/bottomup/v2/scoring_layer.py:score_stat_lines(df, scoring_cfg) — pure arithmetic on stored columns; contains no fit call by construction

portability_demo.claim_demonstrated: same stat lines, different scoring config, different within-position order, zero refits
portability_demo.limitation_stated: bonus thresholds outside the modelled families (rec/rush 100/150/200, pass 300/350/400) need their own exceedance GLM — a stat-data fit, not a league fit; not built in B1

evaluation.steering_metric: spearman_rho_vs_realised_season_points, absolute, per (position, season); comparisons only between own arms (G-family) — never vs any crowd during development
evaluation.population: M-panel veterans (FFC ADP membership defines the evaluation subset only; the column is never a feature and never an ordering input); full universe and rookies descriptive

family.correction: BH at campaign denominator, floor 80 per manifest README

cross_positional._note: replacement levels from roster shape (10-team, 1QB/2RB/3WR/1TE/2FLEX) apply downstream of stat lines; not graded in B1 and must not be claimed as tested
